method: New sharpness-aware minimax training. Each update evaluates MAE, adds radius0.05 normalized-gradient perturbation, recomputes MAE with identical dropout/context masks, restores original weights exactly by copy, takes one AdamW step with perturbed gradient. Same architecture, seeds and optimizer-update count as v304, trained from scratch.
selection: Original v148 algorithm via v314: maximize minimum fold0/1 gain over frozen blends0.20/0.45; require relative MAE gain>0.012. Freeze before fold2/valid; no fallback.
confirmation: All four gains positive; mean>0.012; both 500-replicate paired scaffold bootstrap90% lower bounds positive.
smoke: PASS: independent analytic scalar-gradient optimizer reference, exact restore, stochastic-mask equivalence, finite CUDA gradients, query-label isolation, checkpoint reload, reverse order; no query scores read.
limitations: Public validation heavily reused; upstream historical OOF approximate. This is a distinct training mechanism, not evidence of official gain. No failed v321 output used.
